description: This course offers a toolkit for causal impact analytics, designed to gain actionable insights, and make data-driven decisions across various business domains or verticals such as marketing, finance, and healthcare. The curriculum explores fundamental concepts, methods, and applications of causal impact analytics, e.g., potential outcome models, randomized experiments, instrumental variables, etc. It also covers the latest developments at the nexus of machine learning and causal impact analytics, featuring techniques such as double/debiased machine learning. The objective is to provide participants with the theoretical understanding and practical skills needed to effectively develop and implement causal impact analytics in real-world business scenarios.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must have completed all of BT2101/ST2334 at a grade of at least D)
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (2) ST2334:D, BT2101:D)
title: Causal Impact Analytics for Business Applications
